profile.name: Suraj Pandey
profile.title: Data Analyst | Business Analytics & BI
profile.tagline: Turning finance, sales and data into decisions leadership can act on.
profile.bio: MBA (Finance & IT) candidate at Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University with hands-on expertise in data analysis, business analytics, and business intelligence, alongside direct B2B sales and marketplace management experience. Proficient in Power BI, Advanced Excel, SQL, and Python, with project experience building interactive dashboards, automating KPI reporting, and conducting data-driven financial analysis.

points: Managing B2B sales operations for a chemicals and cleaning products portfolio (battery water, caustic soda flakes, glass cleaner) under the self-created brand "EZ Shine".
Drive marketplace expansion across IndiaMART, TradeIndia, and Flipkart Seller Hub, handling category listings, quality-check compliance, and SLA management.
Own SEO-optimized product listings and pricing for 10+ SKUs, plus a 12-page product catalogue, across B2C and B2B channels.
Coordinate with buyers on bulk/B2B orders, negotiate terms, and maintain client relationships to grow repeat business.
Tracked and analyzed territory performance metrics, compiling data into regular reports for senior management.
Used field data trends to identify engagement opportunities and support decision-making with healthcare stakeholders.
Maintained structured records to monitor targets and performance consistency.
Maintained and analyzed daily financial records and ledger data for chit fund operations.
Tracked member contribution and payout data, reconciling accounts on a monthly basis.
Compiled financial summaries to support audit and compliance reporting.

projects.title: Business Analytics — Power BI Dashboard
projects.description: Built an interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing 15+ KPIs across revenue, expenses, and profitability, cutting manual reporting time by ~30%. Engineered DAX measures for dynamic KPI tracking and automated monthly reporting workflows. Conducted data-driven budgeting and variance analysis, identifying cost-saving opportunities worth an estimated 12% efficiency gain.

projects.title: Stock Market Data Analysis (Python)
projects.description: Analyzed 3+ years of historical stock data across 10 equities using Pandas and Matplotlib to identify trend patterns. Performed risk and performance analysis (volatility, Sharpe ratio) to support data-backed investment decisions. Generated 20+ automated visual reports condensing multi-year datasets into clear business insights.
